# Section 010 Knowledge Check: Access Control For Platform Resources

<!-- TODO(build): generated by /astrona-course-generate-assessment against the objectives below. Scenario questions, no recall trivia. -->

## Coverage

- Create a Role and RoleBinding that give a service account exactly the verbs it needs on one resource in one namespace
- Choose between Role and ClusterRole, and between RoleBinding and ClusterRoleBinding, for a given access requirement
- Check any permission for another identity with kubectl auth can-i --as, including --list
- Read a Forbidden error and name the missing verb, resource and API group
- Find and remove an over-broad binding such as cluster-admin given to a workload service account
- Extend a ClusterRole through aggregation labels instead of editing a built-in role
- Label a namespace to enforce, audit or warn at the baseline or restricted Pod Security Standards level
- Read a Pod Security Admission rejection and name each field that violates the level
- Write a securityContext (runAsNonRoot, allowPrivilegeEscalation, capabilities drop ALL, seccompProfile RuntimeDefault) that passes restricted
- Test a level change against existing workloads with a server-side dry run before enforcing it
- Explain why a Deployment is accepted while its pods are rejected, and find the error in the ReplicaSet events
